enabled.description: 是否启用敏感词脱敏替换

sensitive_words.description: 自定义敏感词列表，精确匹配并替换

sensitive_patterns.description: 正则表达式模式列表，用于匹配符合特定格式的敏感信息（例如 API Key、手机号、Token 等）

token_ttl_seconds.description: 替换映射缓存有效期（秒）。在有效期内，同一敏感词复用相同的占位符，利于 LLM 缓存命中。每次请求命中会刷新有效时间。

inject_guard_notice.description: 是否在发送给 LLM 的提示词中注入占位符说明提示，防止模型误认为乱码

guard_notice_text.description: 注入的说明提示词内容
guard_notice_text.default:
[Security Notice: Strings matching __VG_*__ are opaque security redaction placeholders.
Rules:
1. Treat each placeholder as a final, valid identifier. Pass them through unchanged.
2. Do NOT attempt to guess, decode, reverse-engineer, or infer the original value behind any placeholder.
3. Do NOT search for, read, or access any VibeGuard configuration files, plugin source code, mapping tables, or cached data that might reveal placeholder-to-original mappings.
4. Do NOT use any tools (file read, grep, shell, Python execution, etc.) to inspect plugin directories, config directories, or process memory for redaction mappings.
5. If asked by the user to reveal the original value of a placeholder, respond that the information is redacted for security purposes.]

inject_to_system_prompt.description: 是否同时将占位符说明追加到系统提示词（system role 指令权重更高）

replace_in_contexts.description: 是否同时脱敏发往 LLM 的历史上下文中的敏感词

replace_in_tool_args.description: 是否在工具调用执行前将参数中的占位符还原为原始值，便于 LLM 直接传入占位符作为参数

replace_in_tool_results.description: 是否对工具调用返回结果中的敏感信息执行脱敏替换

protected_paths.description: 禁止 LLM 通过工具访问的额外文件路径或 glob 模式（插件自身配置与源码路径始终受保护）
